hypothesis: the WL76 FIA supervised-fitting failure is dominated by the azimuthally uniform (ring-lobe) outgoing representation of R_theta
unchanged: K/C ownership, homogeneous isotropic volume physics, ballistic B, first-exit semantics, exact SS, second-collision W, four-depth port-column anchors, q = 1024 quadrature with the WL76 per-port seeds and budget rescaling (imported from fnto_fia76/fia76.py, not copied), spatial support (ties-included 512-NN local softmax + 240-cell coarse tail), S16-R training population, physical labels and replicas, objective J, optimiser and schedule, final iterate, evaluation statistics

stage0.removed_by_ring_lobes: each ring lobe is uniform inside each of the 4 polar rings of the 8x8 concentric grid: every azimuthal variation inside a ring (60 of the 64 per-receiver directions) is removed; WL76 post hoc: 0.45 of the reference multiple-scatter native signal lies there (noise 0.002)
stage0.representation: local outgoing distribution O(o) = sum_{m<3} alpha_m L_m(o) + alpha_az Lambda(o), alpha = softmax over 4 components per (pair, channel); Lambda(o) = nu(o) [1 + s a1 cos(phi_o - phi_r) + s a2 cos 2(phi_o - phi_r)] / Z; |a1|,|a2| <= 1/2 (a = tanh(u)/2) so Lambda >= 0; nu a learned ring profile (softmax over rings, uniform inside); phi_o the azimuth of bin o centre in the receiver frame (t, b) of its first triangle; phi_r the azimuth of the tangential part of r = x_j - y_k (anchor -> receiver) in the same frame, geometric and not learned; s = |r_t| / (|r_t| + 1 mm); Z the exact per-pair normaliser. cos(phi_o - phi_r) is invariant under in-plane rotation and reflection of the frame: exactly D4-equivariant wherever the slab symmetry permutes the bins. Runtime basis form: 3 ring lobes + nu x {1, cos, sin, cos2, sin2}(phi_o) = 8 fixed basis functions per channel with per-pair coefficients
stage0.tail: the coarse tail keeps WL76 ring lobes (240 coarse cells have no single tangent frame); its share tau is reported (limitation)
stage0.additional_features: phi_r (anchor -> receiver azimuth) and the radial weight s, both geometric; no new learned input feature
stage0.capacity: WL76 + one wider output head (fA: 3 x 3 -> 6 x 3 outputs) + nu (4 x 3): parameter count recorded by the tests / runs
stage0.initialization: same constructors as WL76 (zero-initialised output layers), seeds 7601 / 7602 as WL76; the azimuthal-lobe mixture logit bias = -2 (weight ~ 0.04), a1 = a2 = 0 at start (the WL76 initial operator up to the small azimuthal share); no warm start from WL76 weights
stage0.expected_cost: state ~ 2.5 GB at rest (shared int32 CSR index over (port, 8 basis) x anchor, one value array per channel); rebuild ~ 75 s (unchanged quadrature) + assembly; apply ~ 2 x WL76

candidate.name: FIA-AZ (WL76 FIA with an azimuth-resolving equivariant outgoing response)
candidate.learned: R_theta only: rho (escape mass), tau (tail share), local / tail spatial softmax with the analytic exp(-r/L_c)/(r^2+1mm^2) prior (L_c learned, init 18.1/5.8/1.8 mm) plus MLP corrections, ring-lobe mixture weights; 6 MLPs (2 hidden layers of 64, SiLU, zero-initialised outputs), 42,565 parameters
candidate.features: anchor: free paths to the boundary along -n, +n and 8 lateral directions (sorted), exp(-d/1mm), depth; receiver: the same from the port (0.25 mm inside) + area ratio, thickness, normal spread, |n_z|; pair: distance/1cm, receiver-normal cosine, normal product, exp(-r/2mm); all invariant to the slab symmetries
candidate.geometry_only_operators: W (cells -> anchors) and SS (cells -> exit port/bin) by fixed-seed quadrature of the current geometry and sigma_t only (per-port seeds 762000000 + 1e7 x geometry index + 16 x port), like the ballistic B; deployable, no reference, no privileged label
candidate.privileged_supervision: none: the candidate trains only on the S16-R collided first-exit targets of the preserved baselines; Stage 1 estimators are validation-only
candidate.material_difference: no learned map from source-port features to spatial transport (W+UV) and no source-receiver relational kernel with a shared incident A (RSK): the incident dependence is entirely geometric (W, SS); the learned part is one source-independent response of an interior isotropic emitter with invariant features and ring lobes; equivariant by construction (no L_sym)
candidate.expected_cost: state: W about P*16*60 nnz, SS up to P*16*1024 nnz before coalescing, local R 4P*512*9 floats (about 280 MB), tail 4P*240*9; apply = 3 sparse products + one scatter over 4P*512 slots

optimizer.objective: WL68 objective J (family68 definition) on the dense prediction, mean over geometries (rest, pt0) of the mean over (source, channel)
optimizer.full_batch: all 16 S16-R sources x 16 bins per step (gradient accumulated over 4-source chunks)

stage1.data: S16-R rest sources, archived training-reference bundles (all replicas: these sources are already supervised; no independent confirmation label)
stage1.diagnostics: per (incoming bin, receiver, channel) least-squares projection of the reference multiple-scatter part M = mean(S) - albedo SS onto (i) ring indicators (4, the WL76 restriction), (ii) the FIA-AZ relaxation {ring x (1, cos(phi_o - phi_r), cos 2(phi_o - phi_r))} (12; phi_r = source -> receiver azimuth), (iii) the free-phase span {ring x (1, cos, sin, cos2, sin2)(phi_o)} (20, reference); relative L2 residual per source with its replica-noise floor
stage1.tests: bin azimuths; per-pair normalisation and positivity with a strongly azimuthal model; synthetic azimuthal target fitted by the lobe form (< 0.05) but not by ring lobes (> 0.3); full native D4 x z-flip equivariance with exact bin permutations (r90, mx + z-flip; within 2 x quadrature-seed noise + 0.01); WL76 physics / CSR / source-independence / objective tests

gate.rule: mean (ii) residual <= 0.5 x mean (i) residual over the 16 sources, else STOP (the angular restriction is not relaxed)

full FIA-AZ runtime at rest and pt0 (initial parameters; cost is structural): state <= 4 GiB, 64-light apply <= 10 x A75 in the same process, physics passes; else STOP (COST INFEASIBLE). Rebuild time reported (the ~75 s quadrature is unchanged by design)

stage3.data: S16-R held-out replicas 4-7 (eval73.load_refs) + WL73 development groups (descriptive); baselines AR_5901/5902 (~/rest_src73/runs) and A75_5901/5902 (~/rest_rank75/runs, copied byte-for-byte from the local WL75 root); labelled G0_r0 / G2_r0 training oracles (WL74 Stage 1 arithmetic)

gate.rule: fit: each FIA seed, every listed group and metric: hi <= 1.25 x max over the AR (rank-8) seeds; validity: runtime physics (zero, positivity, linearity, column sums <= 1, rebuild identity) on rest and pt0; computational: full runtime state <= 4 GiB and 64-light apply <= 10 x the rank-16 baseline in the same process. PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE / INSUFFICIENT FIT / COMPUTATIONAL INFEASIBILITY stop before any Stage 4 reference; GATES PASSED -> Stage 4

stage4.population: ports76.py (geometry only), proposed on the archived rest geometry and RG.geometry(te1) before any WL76 candidate evidence; excludes 81 previously scored ports and all exact images
stage4.references: probes74 code unchanged (WL57 fast walker, gates, 32M, K = 4); seeds 766000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (rest 0, te1 1); rest: all non-empty slots, te1: footprint 24-27

decision.stronger: per group, the preserved baseline (AR or A75) with the lower mean over its two seeds of con_coarse hi
decision.far_rule: far = YES iff max over FIA seeds of BND_FAR con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over the stronger baseline seeds AND < min of their lower 95 % bounds; NO iff min FIA > 0.8 x max stronger; else OVERLAP; near likewise on BND_NEAR
decision.regression_rule: per group/metric vs the better baseline (lower seed mean): YES iff min FIA >= 1.25 x max baseline; NO iff max FIA < 1.25 x min baseline; else OVERLAP
decision.classes: PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE; INCONCLUSIVE (primary unmeasured or far OVERLAP); far YES: TRANSFERABLE BENEFIT (independent far boundary), or TRADE-OFF if a regression is YES; far NO: NO INDEPENDENT BOUNDARY-TRANSFER BENEFIT (+ LOCAL BENEFIT if near YES, + with regression)
decision.absolute_gates: WL59: abs_coarse <= 0.10, abs_fine16 <= 0.15, con_coarse <= 0.25 per group; DEF relative <= 0.35 and corr >= 0.90 (eval73 Qdef); reported separately

stage4.analysis: mechanism: exact single-scatter share of each reference and the error of the learned multiple-scatter part; hi/lo sub-cell pairs; per-source error vs distance; checkpoints; labelled G0/G2 oracles (replica 0 fit, 1-3 score)
stage4.reuse: brief Stage 5: the WL76 Stage 4 population (ports76.json, te1) is reused: frozen geometry-only in fia76_v1, never scored (WL76 stopped at its fit gate; no ~/rest_fia76/refs). The WL76 dev smoke generated 0.5M-photon dev packets for dev slots 2, 3, 24-27 (~/rest_fia76_dev) used only by the forced dev path; no metric was read, nothing was selected from them; WL77 does not read them.
stage4.evaluated: F77 finals + checkpoints, preserved WL76 F76, AR, A75 on the same references; principal endpoint BND_FAR con_coarse vs the stronger learned ATO baseline (AR or A75), 0.8 and beyond the lower 95 % bound, three-valued; regression x1.25; WL59 gates separately

attribution.rule: brief Stage 4, only if the Stage 3 fit gate fails: A native multiple-scatter residual (F77 and F76) vs the Stage 1 floors; B incoming-bin spatial centroid shifts and multiple-scatter contrast (reference vs model); C optimisation (J trajectory, plateau, gradient norms). Labelled diagnostics; no model change

classes: ANGULAR LIMIT SUPPORTED: native multiple-scatter error improves materially (F77 err_ms native <= 0.75 x F76 on the training sources)
FIT RECOVERED: Stage 3 fit gate passes
TRANSFER SUPPORTED: Stage 4 far = YES without a YES regression
RESIDUAL SPATIAL LIMIT: angular limit supported but the fit gate or transfer fails

execution.chain: tests -> Stage 1 expressivity gate -> Stage 2 cost gate -> probe -> 2 fits -> Stage 3 + fit gate -> [pass: population reuse check -> references -> bundle -> Stage 4] | [fail: attribution] -> export; one detached setsid chain; any failure stops; OOM watchdog
execution.lanes_rule: probe both runs concurrently; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane
